name: mexican-train
description: A web version of Mexican Train — the domino game where you build trains off a shared double-12 hub each round, everyone chases the lowest pip total over 13 rounds. Play locally against Ed & Carol, or online against a friend via a shared room code (Firebase-synced).

scripts.dev: npm run build:engine && npm run dev -w packages/client
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build -w packages/client
